meta.name: business-health-diagnostic
meta.description: Diagnose SaaS business health across growth, retention, efficiency, and capital. Use when preparing a business review or prioritizing urgent fixes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 诊断 SaaS 业务健康度，聚焦增长、留存、效率与资本
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要定期审视 SaaS 业务指标或优先处理紧急问题
copy.tagline_en: Diagnose SaaS business health across growth, retention, efficiency, and capital
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to regularly assess SaaS metrics or prioritize urgent fixes

howto.what: 引导你输入增长、留存、单位经济和资本效率四大类指标，然后综合评估SaaS业务健康度，生成健康计分卡并列出优先修复项。
howto.when: 准备董事会汇报、季度复盘或需要紧急定位业务问题根源时，可启动该技能。

say.text: 帮我做一次SaaS业务健康诊断。
say.note: 技能会依次询问各维度指标，最后给出评分和行动建议。

say.text: 我的公司增长很快但现金流紧张，帮我分析单位经济模型。
say.note: 技能会重点评估LTV:CAC、烧钱率等指标并给出建议。

howto.what_en: Guides you to input SaaS metrics across growth, retention, unit economics, and capital efficiency, then diagnoses overall business health with a scorecard and prioritized recommendations.
howto.when_en: Use when preparing a board review, quarterly business review, or urgently needing to identify and prioritize business issues.

say_en.text: Run a business health diagnostic for my SaaS company.
say_en.note: The skill will ask for metrics and deliver a full scorecard.

say_en.text: We're growing fast but burning cash. Analyze our unit economics.
say_en.note: The skill focuses on LTV:CAC, burn rate, and efficiency.
